paragraphs: R' Yonatan, the scribe of Gufta. See the entry on R' Yohanan, the scribe of Gufta.[^1]

notes.text: ספרא is read as scribe, and דגופתא as “of Gufta,” without deciding a modern geographical identification or further sense of the designation. Yonatan and Yohanan remain distinct. The heading and original entry boundary were recorded as provisional; both abbreviated titles remain R'.
